mapper.select: SELECT id, name, branch_name, city, district, address, latitude, longitude, phone, business_hours, status, created_by, created_at, updated_at FROM stores WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, name, branch_name, city, district, address, latitude, longitude, phone, business_hours, status, created_by, created_at, updated_at FROM stores ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT id, name, branch_name, city, district, address, latitude, longitude, phone, business_hours, status, created_by, created_at, updated_at FROM stores WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY name ASC, id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE stores SET name = #{name}, branch_name = #{branchName}, city = #{city}, district = #{district}, address = #{address}, latitude = #{latitude}, longitude = #{longitude}, phone = #{phone}, business_hours = #{businessHours} WHERE id = #{id}
